about: The mini pilot's pages: free corpus only, so this file is tracked. 14 pages have publisher gold, 6 more cover boxes, figures and console code. expected_output_tokens is an estimate for the Markdown form, in API tokens, from the example page p. 179 (1,261 tokens by tiktoken, a measured factor of 1.41 gives about 1,800) scaled by each page's words, blocks, formulas and table cells (2026-10-30); the usage of each result replaces it. A work card is what the reader is told about the work; it comes from looking at the pages. corpus_works names the free works the corpus cell reads whole that have no page in the mini pilot (decision 121.b): their files, for the reader and the search.

work_cards.openstax-finance-2e: A finance textbook in English, one column, nearly every page page_kind body, the printed page number and a running head at the top. A displayed equation has its number at the right margin, as 6.3; 'Figure 6.3' and 'Table 13.10' captions sit below their float, also where the 'figure' is a table printed as an image. Boxes are coloured panels titled THINK IT THROUGH, LINK TO LEARNING or CONCEPTS IN PRACTICE (kind feature), and footnotes are numbered from 1 in each chapter.
work_cards.openstax-accounting: An accounting textbook in English, one column, nearly every page page_kind body, the printed page number and a running head at the top. 'Figure 2.1' and 'Table 4.2' labels sit below their float, a table may also have an unlabelled title above it, some tables are printed as images (raster=1) and exercise tables with empty cells are template=1. Boxes are coloured panels titled THINK IT THROUGH, YOUR TURN, CONCEPTS IN PRACTICE, LINK TO LEARNING, ETHICAL CONSIDERATIONS, IFRS CONNECTION or CONTINUING APPLICATION (kind feature), and footnotes are numbered from 1 in each chapter.

'TABLE 1 |' captions sit above their table and 'FIGURE 2 |' captions below their figure; there are no boxes and no footnotes.
